labs.title: E2E Test Generation Agent
labs.problem: Reduce Cypress test suite writing time while maintaining 100% coverage on complex invoice workflows.
labs.approach: Analysis of User Stories and DDD schema to extract selectors and assertions, dynamic generation of Cypress scripts and consistent fixtures.
labs.result: Reduced test creation time by approximately 70%. Secure critical deployments, eliminated production regressions.

labs.title: CODEX Smart Search
labs.problem: Instantly find a specific code fragment among thousands of assets in the CODEX Registry.
labs.approach: Semantic indexing (embeddings) and similarity search via Vector DB for intent-based search rather than keyword matching.
labs.result: Instant access to already developed solutions, less duplication and time wasted on searching.

labs.title: CODEX Vault & Registry
labs.problem: Archive, visualize and replay fragments of critical applications without duplicating code.
labs.approach: Scalable architecture based on a JSON Registry: a single source of truth for components and automation scripts.
labs.result: A single source of truth for components and scripts, reliable replay of critical workflows.
